global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with tender chashu pork, crisp menma, and shredded cabbage. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it rests on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, black-rimmed edge.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, with visible noodles, green onions, and a pink swirl topping.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, tapered shape.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven, cooked surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
